paragraphs.text: A Prettycoat Farm
paragraphs.translation: A 普雷蒂科特农场

paragraphs.text: This well-known campsite in the wild near Browbourne is a winner with campers who are looking for time out from their fast-paced jobs in the capital. Despite its limited facilities, the site, with its large tent pitches, is an ideal base for exploring the area and driving to the rock museum, the craft workshops or Gaydon Castle. Just follow the signs.
paragraphs.translation:
这个位于布罗伯恩附近荒野的知名露营地深受那些希望在首都快节奏工作中抽身休息的露营者喜爱。
尽管设施有限，但这个拥有宽敞帐篷营地的场地，是探索该地区、驾车前往岩石博物馆、手工艺作坊或盖登城堡的理想基地。
只需按照指示牌前行即可。

paragraphs.text: B Newgammon Wild
paragraphs.translation: B 纽加蒙荒野露营地

paragraphs.text: This campsite looks like it's going to be a winner. It only opened last year, but already the website has some very positive reviews from the handful of campers who know about it so far. It offers splendid views over some of the country's most attractive beaches, which can be accessed by steep, narrow cliff steps. You need a good level of fitness for these, and don't forget to leave some energy for the return trip at the end of the day.
paragraphs.translation:
这个营地看起来将大获成功。
它去年才开放，但网站上已经有一些来自少数了解它的露营者的非常积极的评价。
它提供了一些全国最迷人海滩的壮丽景色，这些海滩可以通过陡峭狭窄的悬崖阶梯到达。
你需要有良好的体能来应对这些，并且别忘了留些体力以便在一天结束时返回。

paragraphs.text: C Oakerly Estate
paragraphs.translation: C 奥克利庄园

paragraphs.text: You won't be disappointed when you reach Oakerly, despite the problems of getting there by car on such narrow roads. You'll see quite a lot of motorhomes when you hit the clifftop, but there's still plenty of room for tents on the spacious lawn that also offers a camp kitchen, restaurant and bar. Make sure you stay safe and pitch your tent within the white line around the cliff edge, though.
paragraphs.translation:
当你抵达奥克雷时，你不会感到失望，尽管开车通过这些狭窄的道路到达那里存在一些问题。
当你到达悬崖顶端时，你会看到相当多的房车，但在宽敞的草坪上仍有充足的空间供帐篷使用，那里还设有营地厨房、餐厅和酒吧。
不过，请确保你保持安全，并在悬崖边缘的白线内搭设帐篷。

paragraphs.text: D South Turnbull
paragraphs.translation: D 南特恩布尔

paragraphs.text: The emphasis at this site is on back-to-basics camping. It's advisable to come in a group as there are few facilities and you need to do all your own cooking. The area is rather exposed, and in periods of bad weather it can't be reached at all so check on the website before you go.
paragraphs.translation:
这个露营地的重点在于回归原始的露营方式。
建议结伴而来，因为设施很少，你需要自己动手做饭。
这个区域相当暴露，在恶劣天气期间根本无法到达，因此去之前请查看网站。

paragraphs.text: E Boxer Trepis
paragraphs.translation: E Boxer Trepis

paragraphs.text: The 20-metre high rockfaces that surround this site are especially attractive to rock climbers, who come here to camp from hundreds of miles away so that they can attempt the climb-and not always with success, according to the website! It's not compulsory, of course, and there are plenty of other activities for campers to get involved in, such as birdwatching and bathing in the sea.
paragraphs.translation:
环绕该营地的20米高岩壁对攀岩者尤其有吸引力，他们从数百英里外赶来露营，以便尝试攀登——而根据网站信息，攀登并非总能成功！
当然，这并不是强制性的，露营者还可以参与许多其他活动，例如观鸟和在海中沐浴。

paragraphs.text: Durridge Heights (DH) Newsletter
paragraphs.translation: 达里奇高地（DH）时事通讯

paragraphs.text: Newsletter for people living in the seven-storey block of flats at Durridge Heights
paragraphs.translation: 面向居住在于里奇高地七层公寓楼居民的通讯稿

paragraphs.text: Dear Residents
paragraphs.translation: 尊敬的居民们

paragraphs.text: Water penetration
paragraphs.translation: 渗水问题

paragraphs.text: As a result of the recent heavy rains, water has seeped through the walls of some flats and reached a critical level. A decision has been taken to deal with this immediately. Scaffolding will be put up on the middle section of the southern wall, and the brickwork there will be sealed temporarily with a waterproof covering to prevent any further water getting in until the major
paragraphs.translation:
由于近期的强降雨，水已经渗入了一些公寓的墙壁，并达到了危急程度。
已决定立即处理这一问题。

paragraphs.text: building works take place next year.
paragraphs.translation: 建筑工程将于明年进行。

paragraphs.text: Fire safety
paragraphs.translation: 消防安全

paragraphs.text: Following our fire safety inspection, the front doors of individual flats were upgraded or replaced in order to satisfy fire safety regulations. As advised in the previous Newsletter, the decoration of the hall side of the front doors will be incorporated into the Fire Safety Project and will be carried out in due course by the company PRQ Builders.
paragraphs.translation:
消防安全
根据我们的消防安全检查结果，各公寓的前门已进行升级或更换，以符合消防安全规定。
如前一期通讯所述，前门大厅一侧的装饰将纳入消防安全项目，并由PRQ建筑公司在适当时候实施。

paragraphs.text: Internal redecorations
paragraphs.translation: 内部重新装修

paragraphs.text: The corridor walls on the inside of the building are redecorated every three years on a rolling basis and are being done this year. Please look out for signs indicating where the paint is wet. If you have children, make sure they keep away from the walls. DH cannot be held responsible for any spoilt clothing.
paragraphs.translation:
大楼内部的走廊墙壁每三年滚动重新装修一次，今年正在进行此工作。
请注意标记油漆未干的指示牌。
如果您有孩子，请确保他们远离墙壁。
DH 对任何被损坏的衣物概不负责。

paragraphs.text: Air fresheners
paragraphs.translation: 空气清新剂

paragraphs.text: We have received a small number of complaints about smells in the corridors. DH installed air fresheners some years ago. However, they were costly and the liquid in their spray stained the carpets. At present, we would prefer to ask residents to make sure smells cannot escape their front door and to seal rubbish bags when they put them in the corridor for collection and disposal by the caretaker.
paragraphs.translation:
空气清新剂
我们收到了少量关于走廊气味的投诉。
DH在几年前安装了空气清新剂。
然而，这些清新剂价格昂贵，而且其喷雾液体弄脏了地毯。
目前，我们更希望请居民确保气味不会从他们的前门逸出，并在将垃圾袋放在走廊以便管理员收集和处理时密封好垃圾袋。

paragraphs.text: Noise and DIY
paragraphs.translation: 噪音与自行装修

paragraphs.text: While most leaseholders observe the regulations on noise, we have received complaints from others about out-of-hours drilling. Please note that any work involving hammers or electrical tools can only take place between 9.00 am and 5.30 pm on weekdays and between 9.00 am and 12.30 pm on a Saturday. There can be no exceptions to this rule. If you are planning to undertake such work during these hours, it is still polite to inform your neighbours of this so that they can make any necessary arrangements.
paragraphs.translation:
虽然大多数租赁业主遵守噪音规定，但我们也收到了其他人关于非工作时间钻孔的投诉。
请注意，任何涉及锤子或电动工具的工作只能在周一至周五上午9:00至下午5:30以及周六上午9:00至下午12:30进行。
此规定没有例外。
如果你计划在这些时段内进行此类工作，仍应礼貌地告知邻居，以便他们能做出必要的安排。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: A day in the life of a care worker

paragraphs.text: Care workers in Britain provide elderly and disabled people with the opportunity to remain independent at home, rather than moving into a care home. For those interested in the work, here is what a typical day could be like for a trained care worker.
paragraphs.translation:
英国的护理工作者为老年人和残疾人提供在家中保持独立的机会，而不是搬进护理院。
对于对这一工作感兴趣的人来说，以下是经过培训的护理工作者典型的一天可能是什么样的。

paragraphs.text: Care workers often start early, as the first client of the day may need help getting out of bed and putting on their clothes; they may suffer from a condition that prevents them from doing this easily. Providing these services helps clients to look and feel as good as possible when beginning their day. The care worker may then help to cook breakfast for the client, and this is often a good time to enjoy a conversation and catch up on how they are feeling. Many clients appreciate being able to chat to someone regularly, as some may have no family members or friends living nearby. Next, the care worker may take the opportunity to do some basic housework for the client. Housework is often something that elderly people or people with disabilities may not be able to do themselves. Even something as simple as hoovering the living room can make a huge difference to a client's day. Of course, there may be the breakfast dishes to do as well.
paragraphs.translation:
护理员通常很早开始工作，因为当天的第一位客户可能需要帮助起床和穿衣；他们可能患有某种疾病，导致他们无法轻松完成这些动作。
提供这些服务有助于客户在开始新的一天时，看起来和感觉上尽可能良好。
然后，护理员可能会帮助客户做早餐，这通常是享受交谈和了解他们近况的好时机。
许多客户很感激能够定期与某人聊天，因为有些人可能没有家人或朋友住在附近。
接下来，护理员可能会利用这个机会为客户做一些基本的家务。
家务活往往是老年人或残疾人自己无法完成的事情。
即使是像用吸尘器打扫客厅这样简单的事情，也能对客户的一天产生巨大影响。
当然，可能还需要清洗早餐的餐具。

paragraphs.text: Later in the morning, the care worker may move on to another client in order to help them prepare their midday meal. Care workers try to ensure this is healthy because it is so important to keep clients fit and well. When that's finished, the care worker may help the client to carry out their shopping by going with them to the local supermarket.
paragraphs.translation:
上午晚些时候，护工可能前往另一位客户家中，协助他们准备午餐。
护工们努力确保饮食健康，因为保持客户身体健康和精神良好至关重要。
完成后，护工可能会陪同客户前往当地超市，帮助他们完成购物。

paragraphs.text: During the afternoon, a care worker may help a third client with an outdoor activity, which could involve going for a short walk in the local area or taking the laundry to the launderette. Elderly people may not feel confident going far on their own, so having
paragraphs.translation:
在下午，护工可能会帮助第三位客户进行一项户外活动，这可能包括在附近短途散步或把衣物送到自助洗衣店。
老年人可能对自己独自走远路缺乏信心，因此有

paragraphs.text: company can be a great help.
paragraphs.translation: 陪伴可以是一种极大的帮助。

paragraphs.text: The care worker may participate in cooking dinner with their last client and, before going home, they may also get out their client's medication. This ensures the client remembers to take it before going to bed.
paragraphs.translation:
护工可能会与最后一位客户一起参与烹制晚餐，而且在回家之前，他们还可能会取出客户的药物。
这确保了客户记得在睡前服药。

paragraphs.text: How to find a good balance between your work and your personal life
paragraphs.translation: 如何在工作和个人生活之间找到良好的平衡

paragraphs.text: A good work-life balance is beneficial to everyone. But how can it be achieved?
paragraphs.translation:
良好的工作与生活平衡对每个人都有益。
但如何才能实现这种平衡呢？

paragraphs.text: The first step is to take a serious look at the amount of time you are devoting to work and set about reducing it. The main benefit most people notice once they stop working too much is an improvement in their general health and well being.
paragraphs.translation:
第一步是认真审视你投入到工作上的时间，并着手减少它。
一旦人们停止过度工作，大多数人注意到的主要益处是他们的整体健康和幸福感的提升。

paragraphs.text: Tips for a healthy work-life balance
paragraphs.translation: 实现健康工作与生活平衡的贴士

paragraphs.text: A recent study showed office workers spend approximately 1,700 hours a year in front of a computer. Ensure that your workstation is set up so you're as comfortable as possible and this will help to minimise the chance of any injuries.
paragraphs.translation:
一项近期研究显示，办公室职员每年在电脑前花费约1700个小时。
确保你的工作站设置得尽可能舒适，这将有助于将受伤的可能性降至最低。

paragraphs.text: Whether it's making a hot drink, going for a walk or simply chatting with a colleague, regular breaks are vital. Your brain needs a break roughly every 90 minutes or concentration declines, leaving you with difficulty focusing and feeling sleepy.
paragraphs.translation:
无论是泡杯热饮、散散步，还是仅仅与同事聊聊天，定期的休息都至关重要。
你的大脑大约每90分钟就需要休息一次，否则注意力会下降，导致你难以集中精神并感到困倦。

paragraphs.text: Setting goals for both your professional and personal life is great. Remember though, to make these realistic, because setting an unattainable goal is the quickest way to damage your confidence.
paragraphs.translation:
为你的职业和个人生活设定目标是很好的。
但请记住，要让这些目标切实可行，因为设定一个无法实现的目标是损害自信的最快方式。

paragraphs.text: Activities such as sports and gymnastics are known to decrease tension and increase endurance, two important factors towards achieving a healthy work-life balance. They also boost your belief that you can do whatever you are faced with.
paragraphs.translation:
众所周知，体育和体操等活动能够减轻紧张感并增强耐力，这是实现健康工作与生活平衡的两个重要因素。
它们还能增强你的信念，让你相信自己能够应对所面临的任何挑战。

paragraphs.text: Sometimes it's easier said than done, but if you're juggling numerous pieces of work on a daily basis, learning to prioritise is key. Try to break down your work into various categories, depending on how urgent and important each piece of work is. This will help you to plan your day and achieve more.
paragraphs.translation:
有时这说起来容易做起来难，但如果你每天都要同时处理大量工作，学会分清主次是关键。
试着根据每项工作的紧急程度和重要性，将你的工作分解成不同的类别。
这将帮助你规划一天的工作，并取得更多成就。

paragraphs.text: Ensure you have time to do the things that make you happy. If you've got nothing nice to look forward to and can only see a long line of work days ahead of you, this can easily become overwhelming and ultimately hinder your productivity.
paragraphs.translation:
确保你有时间去做那些让你快乐的事情。
如果你没有什么值得期待的美好事物，只能看到眼前漫长的工作日，这很容易让你不堪重负，最终降低你的工作效率。

paragraphs.text: It's there for a reason and there are no prizes for giving it up, so make sure you take your annual holiday entitlement. You don't have to be going on an exotic foreign trip-maybe you just fancy a rest day watching films or you want to take some time off to spend with a friend you don't see enough.
paragraphs.translation:
它存在是有原因的，而且放弃它没有任何回报，所以请确保你休完你的年假权利。
你不必去一次异国旅行——也许你只是想要一个休息日看电影，或者你想抽出一些时间陪伴一个你很少见到的朋友。

paragraphs.text: Family, friends and favourite pets are the ultimate life enhancers. From evenings out to simply taking a walk in the sunshine, spending time with the ones you love is the best way to unwind fully and feel the effects of a good work-life balance.
paragraphs.translation:
家庭、朋友和心爱的宠物是生活的终极增色剂。
从夜晚外出到只是在阳光下散步，与你所爱的人共度时光是彻底放松并体会到良好工作与生活平衡之益的最佳途径。

parts.source_article_title: A day in the life of a care worker

sentence_translations.sentence: Care workers in Britain provide elderly and disabled people with the opportunity to remain independent at home, rather than moving into a care home.
sentence_translations.translation: 英国的护理工作者为老年人和残疾人提供在家中保持独立的机会，而不是搬进护理院。

sentence_translations.sentence: For those interested in the work, here is what a typical day could be like for a trained care worker.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于对这一工作感兴趣的人来说，以下是经过培训的护理工作者典型的一天可能是什么样的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Care workers often start early, as the first client of the day may need help getting out of bed and putting on their clothes; they may suffer from a condition that prevents them from doing this easily.
sentence_translations.translation: 护理员通常很早开始工作，因为当天的第一位客户可能需要帮助起床和穿衣；他们可能患有某种疾病，导致他们无法轻松完成这些动作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Providing these services helps clients to look and feel as good as possible when beginning their day.
sentence_translations.translation: 提供这些服务有助于客户在开始新的一天时，看起来和感觉上尽可能良好。

sentence_translations.sentence: The care worker may then help to cook breakfast for the client, and this is often a good time to enjoy a conversation and catch up on how they are feeling.
sentence_translations.translation: 然后，护理员可能会帮助客户做早餐，这通常是享受交谈和了解他们近况的好时机。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many clients appreciate being able to chat to someone regularly, as some may have no family members or friends living nearby.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多客户很感激能够定期与某人聊天，因为有些人可能没有家人或朋友住在附近。

sentence_translations.sentence: Next, the care worker may take the opportunity to do some basic housework for the client.
sentence_translations.translation: 接下来，护理员可能会利用这个机会为客户做一些基本的家务。

sentence_translations.sentence: Housework is often something that elderly people or people with disabilities may not be able to do themselves.
sentence_translations.translation: 家务活往往是老年人或残疾人自己无法完成的事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: Even something as simple as hoovering the living room can make a huge difference to a client's day.
sentence_translations.translation: 即使是像用吸尘器打扫客厅这样简单的事情，也能对客户的一天产生巨大影响。

sentence_translations.sentence: Of course, there may be the breakfast dishes to do as well.
sentence_translations.translation: 当然，可能还需要清洗早餐的餐具。

sentence_translations.sentence: Later in the morning, the care worker may move on to another client in order to help them prepare their midday meal.
sentence_translations.translation: 上午晚些时候，护工可能前往另一位客户家中，协助他们准备午餐。

sentence_translations.sentence: Care workers try to ensure this is healthy because it is so important to keep clients fit and well.
sentence_translations.translation: 护工们努力确保饮食健康，因为保持客户身体健康和精神良好至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: When that's finished, the care worker may help the client to carry out their shopping by going with them to the local supermarket.
sentence_translations.translation: 完成后，护工可能会陪同客户前往当地超市，帮助他们完成购物。

sentence_translations.sentence: During the afternoon, a care worker may help a third client with an outdoor activity, which could involve going for a short walk in the local area or taking the laundry to the launderette.
sentence_translations.translation: 在下午，护工可能会帮助第三位客户进行一项户外活动，这可能包括在附近短途散步或把衣物送到自助洗衣店。

sentence_translations.sentence: Elderly people may not feel confident going far on their own, so having
sentence_translations.translation: 老年人可能对自己独自走远路缺乏信心，因此有

sentence_translations.sentence: company can be a great help.
sentence_translations.translation: 陪伴可以是一种极大的帮助。

sentence_translations.sentence: The care worker may participate in cooking dinner with their last client and, before going home, they may also get out their client's medication.
sentence_translations.translation: 护工可能会与最后一位客户一起参与烹制晚餐，而且在回家之前，他们还可能会取出客户的药物。

sentence_translations.sentence: This ensures the client remembers to take it before going to bed.
sentence_translations.translation: 这确保了客户记得在睡前服药。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to find a good balance between your work and your personal life
sentence_translations.translation: 如何在工作和个人生活之间找到良好的平衡

sentence_translations.sentence: A good work-life balance is beneficial to everyone.
sentence_translations.translation: 良好的工作与生活平衡对每个人都有益。

sentence_translations.sentence: But how can it be achieved?
sentence_translations.translation: 但如何才能实现这种平衡呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: The first step is to take a serious look at the amount of time you are devoting to work and set about reducing it.
sentence_translations.translation: 第一步是认真审视你投入到工作上的时间，并着手减少它。

sentence_translations.sentence: The main benefit most people notice once they stop working too much is an improvement in their general health and well being.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦人们停止过度工作，大多数人注意到的主要益处是他们的整体健康和幸福感的提升。

sentence_translations.sentence: Tips for a healthy work-life balance
sentence_translations.translation: 实现健康工作与生活平衡的贴士

sentence_translations.sentence: A recent study showed office workers spend approximately 1,700 hours a year in front of a computer.
sentence_translations.translation: 一项近期研究显示，办公室职员每年在电脑前花费约1700个小时。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ensure that your workstation is set up so you're as comfortable as possible and this will help to minimise the chance of any injuries.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保你的工作站设置得尽可能舒适，这将有助于将受伤的可能性降至最低。

sentence_translations.sentence: Whether it's making a hot drink, going for a walk or simply chatting with a colleague, regular breaks are vital.
sentence_translations.translation: 无论是泡杯热饮、散散步，还是仅仅与同事聊聊天，定期的休息都至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your brain needs a break roughly every 90 minutes or concentration declines, leaving you with difficulty focusing and feeling sleepy.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的大脑大约每90分钟就需要休息一次，否则注意力会下降，导致你难以集中精神并感到困倦。

sentence_translations.sentence: Setting goals for both your professional and personal life is great.
sentence_translations.translation: 为你的职业和个人生活设定目标是很好的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Remember though, to make these realistic, because setting an unattainable goal is the quickest way to damage your confidence.
sentence_translations.translation: 但请记住，要让这些目标切实可行，因为设定一个无法实现的目标是损害自信的最快方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: Activities such as sports and gymnastics are known to decrease tension and increase endurance, two important factors towards achieving a healthy work-life balance.
sentence_translations.translation: 众所周知，体育和体操等活动能够减轻紧张感并增强耐力，这是实现健康工作与生活平衡的两个重要因素。

sentence_translations.sentence: They also boost your belief that you can do whatever you are faced with.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们还能增强你的信念，让你相信自己能够应对所面临的任何挑战。

sentence_translations.sentence: Sometimes it's easier said than done, but if you're juggling numerous pieces of work on a daily basis, learning to prioritise is key.
sentence_translations.translation: 有时这说起来容易做起来难，但如果你每天都要同时处理大量工作，学会分清主次是关键。

sentence_translations.sentence: Try to break down your work into various categories, depending on how urgent and important each piece of work is.
sentence_translations.translation: 试着根据每项工作的紧急程度和重要性，将你的工作分解成不同的类别。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will help you to plan your day and achieve more.
sentence_translations.translation: 这将帮助你规划一天的工作，并取得更多成就。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ensure you have time to do the things that make you happy.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保你有时间去做那些让你快乐的事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you've got nothing nice to look forward to and can only see a long line of work days ahead of you, this can easily become overwhelming and ultimately hinder your productivity.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你没有什么值得期待的美好事物，只能看到眼前漫长的工作日，这很容易让你不堪重负，最终降低你的工作效率。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's there for a reason and there are no prizes for giving it up, so make sure you take your annual holiday entitlement.
sentence_translations.translation: 它存在是有原因的，而且放弃它没有任何回报，所以请确保你休完你的年假权利。

sentence_translations.sentence: You don't have to be going on an exotic foreign trip-maybe you just fancy a rest day watching films or you want to take some time off to spend with a friend you don't see enough.
sentence_translations.translation: 你不必去一次异国旅行——也许你只是想要一个休息日看电影，或者你想抽出一些时间陪伴一个你很少见到的朋友。

sentence_translations.sentence: Family, friends and favourite pets are the ultimate life enhancers.
sentence_translations.translation: 家庭、朋友和心爱的宠物是生活的终极增色剂。

sentence_translations.sentence: From evenings out to simply taking a walk in the sunshine, spending time with the ones you love is the best way to unwind fully and feel the effects of a good work-life balance.
sentence_translations.translation: 从夜晚外出到只是在阳光下散步，与你所爱的人共度时光是彻底放松并体会到良好工作与生活平衡之益的最佳途径。

parts.article_title: City's 'Henry' programme gives children choices while helping parents stay in the driving seat

paragraphs.text: Leeds has become the first city in the UK to report a drop in childhood obesity after introducing a programme called 'Henry'to help parents set boundaries for their children and put them off sweets and junk food. Only a few cities in the world, notably Amsterdam, have managed to cut child obesity. As in Amsterdam, the decline in Leeds is most marked among families living in the most deprived areas, where the problem is worst and hardest to tackle.
paragraphs.translation:
利兹成为英国首个报告儿童肥胖率下降的城市，此前该市推出了一项名为‘亨利’的计划，旨在帮助父母为孩子设定界限，并让他们远离糖果和垃圾食品。
世界上仅有少数城市，尤其是阿姆斯特丹，成功降低了儿童肥胖率。
与阿姆斯特丹类似，利兹市儿童肥胖率的下降在生活在最贫困地区的家庭中最为显著，而这些地区的问题最为严重且最难解决。

paragraphs.text: 'The improvement in the most deprived children in Leeds is startling,'said Susan Jebb, a professor of diet and population health at Oxford University, whose team has analysed the city's data. Over four years, obesity has dropped from 11.5% to 10.5% and the trajectory is steadily downwards. Among the more affluent families, there was also a decline from 6.8% to 6%. Overall the drop was from 9.4% to 8.8%. The data comes from the national child measurement programme (NCMP), which requires all children to be weighed at the start and end of primary school. The biggest decline in obesity in Leeds is 6.4% in the reception class, at about the age of four.
paragraphs.translation:
“‘利兹最贫困儿童状况的改善令人震惊，”牛津大学饮食与人口健康教授苏珊·杰布说，她的团队分析了该城市的数据。
在四年期间，肥胖率从11.5%下降到10.5%，且呈持续下降趋势。
在较为富裕的家庭中，肥胖率也从6.8%下降到了6%。
总体而言，肥胖率从9.4%下降到8.8%。
这些数据来自国家儿童测量计划，该计划要求所有儿童在小学入学和毕业时测量体重。
利兹肥胖率下降最大的群体是学前班儿童，年龄大约在四岁，下降幅度为6.4%。

paragraphs.text: No such data has been reported elsewhere in the UK, where childhood obesity is a major concern. The measurement programme shares the progress made in each city with those considered comparable. For Leeds, the 15 closest 'neighbours'at the start of its study period in 2009 were Sheffield, Kirklees, Bristol, Newcastle upon Tyne, Coventry, Bolton, Wakefield, Derby, Bradford, Dudley, Medway, Liverpool, Swindon, County Durham and Warrington. The obesity rates there and across the country have not shifted. Susan Jebb added that the dropping rate in Leeds appeared to be a trend. This is four years, not one rogue data point,'she said at the European Congress on Obesity in Glasgow where she presented the research.
paragraphs.translation:
英国其他地区尚未报告此类数据，而儿童肥胖问题在那里是一个重大关切。
该测量计划与被认为具有可比性的城市共享每个城市取得的进展。
对于利兹，其在2009年研究期开始时的15个最接近的“邻居”包括谢菲尔德、柯克利斯、布里斯托尔、泰恩河畔纽卡斯尔、考文垂、博尔顿、韦克菲尔德、德比、布拉德福德、达德利、梅德韦、利物浦、斯温顿、达勒姆郡和沃灵顿。
这些地区以及全国范围内的肥胖率并未发生变化。
苏珊·杰布补充说，利兹的下降率似乎是一种趋势。
她在格拉斯哥举行的欧洲肥胖大会上介绍这项研究时表示：“这是四年的数据，而不是一个异常的孤立数据点。”

paragraphs.text: Jebb, a former government adviser, says they cannot be sure what has turned the tide in Leeds-but it could involve a programme called 'Henry' that the city introduced as the core of its obesity strategy in 2009, focusing particularly on the youngest children and poorest families. 'Henry' (Health, Exercise, Nutrition for the Really Young) supports parents in setting boundaries for their children and taking a positive stance on issues from healthy eating to bedtimes.
paragraphs.translation:
曾任政府顾问的杰布表示，他们无法确定是什么扭转了利兹的趋势——但这可能与一项名为“亨利”的计划有关，该市于2009年将其作为肥胖症战略的核心引入，特别关注最年幼的儿童和最贫困的家庭。
“亨利”（面向幼儿的健康、运动与营养计划）支持父母为孩子设定界限，并在从健康饮食到就寝时间等问题上采取积极立场。

paragraphs.text: 'Henry's'chief executive, Kim Roberts, said the drop in obesity in Leeds was 'unprecedented... The indicators are that this isn't happening in other cities'. The programme encourages authoritative rather than authoritarian parenting, she said. 'Authoritarian parenting is when children are told what to eat and what to do, such as being banned from leaving the table until they have eaten their sprouts,'said Roberts.'Permissive parenting is asking children what they want to do. But 'Henry' encourages a third approach known as authoritative parenting, where parents make it clear they are in charge, but also respond to their children.'Instead of being asked what vegetable they want with dinner, children might be asked whether they would like carrots or broccoli. Instead of being told to go to bed, they are asked where they want to read their story beforehand.
paragraphs.translation:
“亨利”项目首席执行官金·罗伯茨表示，利兹肥胖率的下降是“前所未有的……种种迹象表明，其他城市并未出现这种情况”。
她说，该项目鼓励权威型而非专制型育儿方式。
“专制型育儿就是告诉孩子该吃什么、该做什么，比如禁止他们离开餐桌直到吃完豆芽，”罗伯茨说。“放任型育儿则是问孩子想做什么。
但‘亨利’项目鼓励第三种方式，即权威型育儿，父母明确表明自己掌握主导权，同时也会回应孩子的需求。与其问孩子晚餐想吃什么蔬菜，不如问他们想要胡萝卜还是西兰花。
与其命令孩子上床睡觉，不如问他们想在哪里先读故事。

paragraphs.text: Lisa, who joined a 'Henry' parenting course when her oldest daughter was two, is enthusiastic about her family's experience of the programme. She learned a lot about healthy eating, saved money by planning meals and lost two stone herself.'I think it
paragraphs.translation:
丽莎在她大女儿两岁时参加了“亨利”育儿课程，她对这项计划给她家庭带来的体验充满热情。
她学到了很多关于健康饮食的知识，通过计划餐食节省了开支，并且自己减掉了两英石（约12.7公斤）。
“我认为这

paragraphs.text: made me a better parent because of all the parenting skills stuff. I was able to share some of the ideas with my partner and as a result the kids became calmer and happier, which helped us feel less stressed too,'she said.
paragraphs.translation:
由于所有的育儿技能知识，这让我成为了一个更好的家长。
她说：“我能够与我的伴侣分享一些想法，结果孩子们变得更加平静快乐，这也帮助我们感到压力更小。”

paragraphs.text: Janice Burberry, the head of public health at Leeds city council, said the early years were a good time to intervene to support families.'Parents want to do the best for their children,'she said.'We wanted to focus on prevention because it's very, very
paragraphs.translation:
利兹市议会公共卫生负责人珍妮丝·伯贝里表示，早期是干预和支持家庭的好时机。
“父母都想为孩子做到最好，”她说。
“我们希望专注于预防，因为这非常非常

paragraphs.text: difficult when obesity has taken hold to tackle it. We understand that there is no magic bullet here. Parents are experts in their own lives, and they know what they can and can't achieve. The strategy of 'Henry'is about sitting alongside parents and thinking
paragraphs.translation:
当肥胖问题根深蒂固时，处理起来就非常困难。
我们明白，这里没有捷径可走。
父母是自己生活的专家，他们清楚自己能实现什么、不能实现什么。
'Henry'计划的策略是与父母并肩而坐，共同思考

paragraphs.text: through what's right for them.
paragraphs.translation:
什么对他们来说是正确的。
探讨什么对他们来说是合适的。

paragraphs.text: The public health minister, Seema Kennedy, was enthusiastic.'There are some fantastic pockets of work happening in early years already, and while still in the early phases, it is encouraging to see what can be achieved locally through interventions like this,' she said.'I know how hard it can be for busy parents to make healthy choices for their families, so anything that can make it easier is a real lifeline.'
paragraphs.translation:
公共卫生部长西玛·肯尼迪对此充满热情。
她说道：“早期教育领域已经涌现出一些出色的工作成果，尽管仍处于初步阶段，但看到通过此类干预措施在当地取得的成效令人鼓舞。”
“我知道忙碌的父母为家庭做出健康选择有多困难，因此任何能让这一过程变得更简单的事情都是一条真正的生命线。”

questions.prompt: In the first paragraph, what does the writer say about Amsterdam?

options.label: Its 'Henry' programme was recommended to Leeds experts.

questions.analysis: 题干询问作者在第一段中对阿姆斯特丹（Amsterdam）的说法。原文提到“Only a few cities in the world, notably Amsterdam, have managed to cut child obesity. As in Amsterdam, the decline in Leeds is most marked among families living in the most deprived areas”，说明阿姆斯特丹和利兹（Leeds）在减少儿童肥胖方面的模式相似，尤其是在最贫困家庭中效果最明显。因此，选项D“其减少儿童肥胖的成功模式与利兹类似”正确，而其他选项在文中均无依据。
questions.reason: 原文明确提到Amsterdam也成功减少儿童肥胖，且模式与Leeds类似。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说Amsterdam也减少了儿童肥胖，且模式与Leeds相似，故选D。

evidence: Leeds has become the first city in the UK to report a drop in childhood obesity after introducing a programme called 'Henry'to help parents set boundaries for their children and put them off sweets and junk food. Only a few cities in the world, notably Amsterdam, have managed to cut child obesity. As in Amsterdam, the decline in Leeds is most marked among families living in the most deprived areas, where the problem is worst and hardest to tackle.

wrong_reasons.A: 原文未提及阿姆斯特丹的‘Henry’项目被推荐给利兹专家，属于无中生有。

wrong_reasons.C: 原文中阿姆斯特丹的儿童肥胖程度并未比利兹更严重，与原文信息矛盾。
